title: Harry Potter season fondue (red Meltie mug, floor rug) — restage 05
notes: Restage 05 of shorts/uMl76XX7epo: RED variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photos), the treats on the low wooden tray on a fluffy cream rug (a low wooden tray on a fluffy cream shag rug on the living-room floor at night, the front of a caramel leather sofa with cushions and a throw just behind, fairy lights on the wall) instead of the white desk in front of red curtains. Table decor kept (pumpkins, gnome pumpkin, candle jar, laptop). Reworded hook. The pour and the last dip spill on purpose (brief). Laptop: generated fantasy stills; plain unbranded red bag; Sora audio.
hook: When the rain starts and it feels

setting.style: Cosy autumn movie night at home in the evening, at a FLOOR PICNIC: everything happens on the low wooden tray on a fluffy cream rug; a dim warm room lit only by warm fairy lights and a lamp and the candle, deep soft shadows, no bright studio light, no red curtains.
